scripts.text:
[Einbroch Guide]
Welcome
to Einbroch,
the City of Steel.
Please ask me if you
have any questions.
scripts.translation:
[艾音布罗克向导]
欢迎来到钢铁之城，艾音布罗克。
如果您有任何问题，请随时向我提问。

scripts.text: City Guide.
scripts.translation: 城市向导

scripts.text: Remove Marks from Mini-Map.
scripts.translation: 移除小地图标记

scripts.text: Notice.
scripts.translation: 告示

scripts.text: Cancel.
scripts.translation: 取消

scripts.text:
[Einbroch Guide]
Please select
a location from
the following menu.
Would you like me
to mark locations
on your Mini-Map?
scripts.translation:
[艾音布罗克向导]
请从以下菜单中选择一个地点。
您希望我在小地图上标记这些地点吗？

scripts.text:
[Einbroch Guide]
Please select
a location from
the following menu.
scripts.translation:
[艾音布罗克向导]
请从以下菜单中选择一个地点。

scripts.text:
[Einbroch Guide]
Please select
a location from
the following menu.
[Einbroch Guide]
The ^FF0000Airport^000000 is located
in the northwestern part
of the city. There you can
see our city's pride and joy, the Airship. Remember that you must pay admission to board the Airship.
scripts.translation:
[艾音布罗克向导]
请从以下菜单中选择一个地点。
[艾音布罗克向导]
^FF0000机场^000000位于城市的西北部。在那里您可以看到我们城市的骄傲——飞空艇。请记住，乘坐飞空艇需要支付入场费。

scripts.text:
[Einbroch Guide]
Please select
a location from
the following menu.
[Einbroch Guide]
The Train Station is
located in the northeast
part of Einbroch. Trains
running between here
and Einbech run all day
long, everyday.
scripts.translation:
[艾音布罗克向导]
请从以下菜单中选择一个地点。
[艾音布罗克向导]
火车站位于艾音布罗克的东北部。往返于艾音布罗克和艾音贝赫之间的火车全天运行，每天如此。

scripts.text:
[Einbroch Guide]
Please select
a location from
the following menu.
[Einbroch Guide]
The Factory, perhaps the
most important facility in
Einbroch, is located in the
southern part of the city.
scripts.translation:
[艾音布罗克向导]
请从以下菜单中选择一个地点。
[艾音布罗克向导]
工厂，也许是艾音布罗克最重要的设施，位于城市的南部。

scripts.text:
[Einbroch Guide]
Please select
a location from
the following menu.
[Einbroch Guide]
The Plaza, our biggest
shopping district, can be
found just east from the
center of Einbroch.
scripts.translation:
[艾音布罗克向导]
请从以下菜单中选择一个地点。
[艾音布罗克向导]
广场是我们最大的购物区，位于艾音布罗克中心的东侧。

scripts.text:
[Einbroch Guide]
Please select
a location from
the following menu.
[Einbroch Guide]
The Hotel is east of
the Plaza and offers top
caliber accomodations.
There, you can enjoy your
stay in Einbroch in comfort~
scripts.translation:
[艾音布罗克向导]
请从以下菜单中选择一个地点。
[艾音布罗克向导]
酒店位于广场以东，提供顶级的住宿服务。在那里，您可以舒适地享受在艾音布罗克的停留~

scripts.text:
[Einbroch Guide]
Please select
a location from
the following menu.
[Einbroch Guide]
The Weapon Shop is
located north from the
Plaza. There you can
purchase weapons for
your personal use.
scripts.translation:

请从以下菜单中选择一个地点。
[艾音布罗克向导]
武器店位于广场以北。在那里您可以购买供个人使用的武器。

scripts.text:

Please select
a location from
the following menu.
[Einbroch Guide]

annex of the Factory and
is located in the southwest
sector of Einbroch.
scripts.translation:

请从以下菜单中选择一个地点。

scripts.text:

a location from
the following menu.

by using their services.

请从以下菜单中选择一个地点。
[艾音布罗克向导]
铁匠公会展位于艾音布罗克的东南部。您可以使用他们的服务来升级您的装备。

scripts.text:

a location from
the following menu.

[Einbroch Guide]
Please ask me to ''Remove
Marks from Mini-Map'' if you
no longer wish to have the
location marks displayed
on your Mini-Map.
scripts.translation:

如果您不想在小地图上显示位置标记，请告诉我“移除小地图标记”。

scripts.text:
[Einbroch Guide]
Okay, the marks from
your Mini-Map have been
removed. If you need any
guidance around Einbroch,
please let me or one of the
other Einbroch Guides know.
scripts.translation:
[艾音布罗克向导]
好的，您小地图上的标记已被移除。如果您需要关于艾音布罗克的任何指引，请告诉我或其他艾音布罗克向导。

scripts.text:
[Einbroch Guide]
Through the technology of
the Schwarzwald Republic,
we've upgraded to a digital
information system that allows
us to mark locations on your
Mini-Map for easier navigation.
scripts.translation:
[艾音布罗克向导]
借助修瓦鲁兹巴鲁德共和国的技术，我们升级到了数字资讯系统，允许我们在您的小地图上标记位置，以便更轻松地导航。

scripts.text:
[Einbroch Guide]
Your Mini-Map is located
in the upper right corner
of the screen. If you can't
see it, press the Ctrl + Tab
keys or click the ''Map'' button in your Basic Info Window.
scripts.translation:
[艾音布罗克向导]
您的小地图位于屏幕的右上角。如果您看不到它，请按Ctrl + Tab键，或点击“基本资讯”窗口中的“地图”按钮。

scripts.text:
[Einbroch Guide]
On your Mini-Map,
click on the ''+'' and ''-''
symbols to zoom in and
our of your Mini-Map. We
hope you enjoy your travels
here in Einbroch, adventurer.
scripts.translation:
[艾音布罗克向导]
在小地图上，点击“+”和“-”符号可以放大或缩小小地图。我们希望您在艾音布罗克的旅程愉快，冒险者。

scripts.text:
[Einbroch Guide]
We hope that you
enjoy your travels
here in Einbroch.
Oh, and please be
aware of the Smog Alerts.
scripts.translation:
[艾音布罗克向导]
我们希望您在艾音布罗克的旅程愉快。
哦，还有，请注意烟雾警报。

scripts.text:
[Einbech Guide]
Welcome to Einbech,
the Mining Town. We're
here to assist tourists,
so if you have any questions,
please feel free to ask us.
scripts.translation:

欢迎来到艾音贝赫，矿业城镇。我们在这里为游客提供帮助，如果您有任何问题，请随时询问我们。
